float64_cpu: asserted for every arm before its first frame (scripts/39 Arm)

input_files.note: sha256 at the start of the run; the git status of every input inside the repository is in 'git'. The archived QE outputs and the band geometries (../bands) are not hashed: they are tied to the hashed dataset by the fail-closed cross-check (data_cross_check)

definitions.work: W(i*) = -sum_k 1/2 (F_k + F_k+1) . dr_k over images 0 -> ... -> i* of {0, 2, 3, 4}; dr_k minimum-image (ase find_mic, band cell); per atom, meV
definitions.closure: W(i*) - [E(i*) - E(0)], i* each level's own argmax over images 2-4 (DFT: raw F)
definitions.D2b: dF = F_finetuned - F_zeroshot on the DFT-argmax segment; closure vs the direct E_a change (own argmax each) and vs the change of E(i*) - E(0) on that segment
definitions.D2c: dF = F_finetuned - F_DFT (raw F), same segment; direct = E_a(FT) - E_a(DFT raw)
definitions.groups: image 0, minimum image, distances to the hop midpoint; hop_I = the I with the largest image-0 -> image-6 displacement; molecules by scripts/38 molecule(), assigned whole by their C; near = d < 6 A, far = d >= 6 A
definitions.shares: group sum / sum over the five groups (they add to 1; a group can exceed 1 or be negative when groups carry opposite signs)
definitions.side_above_half: per band, which side carries more than half the summed attribution (local = hop_I + inorganic_near); counted for Q4 only over resolved bands
definitions.segments_beside: W and closure of the single segments 0-2, 2-3, 3-4 (reported, no rule)

departures_from_plan: Q4 with no resolved band is reported as 'cannot be read', not as the plan's literal 'mixed' (with n = 0 neither count can exceed n/2, so the literal 'otherwise' branch is vacuous); the literal result is kept beside as plan_literal_reading
interpretations_of_plan: resolved = |DFT closure| <= 20 meV; Q4 shares are of the summed attribution (the five groups add to 1)

groups at image 0 and minimum image: distances to the hop midpoint r_I(0) + 1/2 mic(r_I(6) - r_I(0)); inorganic = not C, N or H; molecules by scripts/38 molecule(), assigned whole by the distance of their C
additions_to_plan: a summary of D2b and D2c over all 37 bands (all_37_bands_beside): not a Q4 reading and not evidence for one; its share counts are named not_a_reading_share_counts and carry the attribution closure scale
per-segment closures (0-2, 2-3, 3-4) beside D2a; the D2b closure also against the change of E(i*) - E(0) on the DFT segment; the D2c counts and per-split counts beside Q4
reproduction of the 37 band E_a values of wp3_eval.json (task rule, exit 6); dataset vs archived QE cross-check (exit 5)

Q4.question: is the systematic E_a lowering carried mainly by the hopping I and its first shell, or by the far field and the organic sublattice?
Q4.rule: D2b over the resolved bands: 'mainly local' if hop_I + inorganic_near carry > 1/2 of the summed change in more than half the resolved bands; 'mainly far or organic' if inorganic_far + organic_near + organic_far do; otherwise 'mixed'
